permitDetails.rightOfEntryClause: The permittee shall allow authorized local, state, and federal representatives, upon the presentation of credentials: to enter upon the permittee's premises on which the facility is located or in which any records are required to be kept under the terms and conditions of this permit; to have access to and copy at reasonable times any records required to be kept; to inspect at reasonable times any facility, equipment, or process subject to the terms and conditions of this permit; and to sample or test at reasonable times. For purposes of this condition, the time for inspection shall be deemed reasonable during regular business hours or whenever the facility is in operation.

generatorSets.fuelGrade: grade ultra low sulfur 2-D or grade 2-D S15
generatorSets.fuelChangePermitTrigger: A change in fuel type or sulfur content may require a permit to modify and operate.
generatorSets.operatingHoursPerUnitRollingWindow: calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive twelve month period
generatorSets.allowedOperatingModes: Emergency; ISO-Declared Emergency (operations under this scenario shall not exceed 60 hours per generator each calendar year); Critical Power Generation; Alternate Power Generation (units equipped with SCR may be operated voluntarily for peak-shaving, demand response, or as part of an interruptible power supply arrangement when operating at a load level necessary to sustain urea injection); periodic maintenance, testing, and operational training.
generatorSets.observationFrequency: Observed by the permittee at a minimum frequency of once per day during each test firing and during days in which the engine generator sets are called into service.
